name: @low-orbit/bruin
description: 🐻 History-enabled state management for React, built on Zustand

scripts.build: pnpm run prebuild && pnpm run "/^build:.*/" && pnpm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: pnpm run patch-d-ts && pnpm run copy && pnpm run patch-old-ts && pnpm run patch-esm-ts
scripts.fix: pnpm run fix:lint && pnpm run fix:format
scripts.pretest: pnpm run fix:format && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tsup
scripts.test: pnpm run test:format && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:spec:all
scripts.test:spec:all: pnpm run test:spec && pnpm run test:spec:tsup-cjs && pnpm run test:spec:tsup-esm && pnpm run test:spec:cjs && pnpm run test:spec:esm
scripts.patch-d-ts: node --input-type=module -e "import { entries } from './rollup.config.mjs'; import shelljs from 'shelljs'; const { find, sed } = shelljs; find('dist/**/*.d.ts').forEach(f => { entries.forEach(({ find, replacement }) => { sed('-i', new RegExp(' from \'' + find.source.slice(0, -1) + '\';$'), ' from \'' + replacement + '\';', f); }); sed('-i', / from '(\.[^']+)\.ts';$/, ' from \'\$1\';', f); });"
scripts.copy: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'fs'; import { cpSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync, renameSync } from 'fs'; import { join } from 'path'; if (existsSync('dist-tsup')) { const copyRecursive = (src, dest) => { mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); const entries = readdirSync(src); entries.forEach(entry => { const srcPath = join(src, entry); const destPath = join(dest, entry); const stat = statSync(srcPath); if (stat.isDirectory()) { copyRecursive(srcPath, destPath); } else { cpSync(srcPath, destPath); } }); }; const moveToEsm = (dir, baseDir = 'dist') => { const entries = readdirSync(dir); entries.forEach(entry => { const fullPath = join(dir, entry); const stat = statSync(fullPath); if (stat.isDirectory()) { moveToEsm(fullPath, baseDir); } else if (entry.endsWith('.mjs') || entry.endsWith('.mts')) { const relPath = fullPath.replace(baseDir + '/', ''); const esmPath = join('dist/esm', relPath); mkdirSync(join(esmPath, '..'), { recursive: true }); renameSync(fullPath, esmPath); } }); }; copyRecursive('dist-tsup', 'dist'); moveToEsm('dist'); }" && shx rm -rf dist/{src,tests} 2>/dev/null || true && shx cp package.json README.md LICENSE dist && json -I -f dist/package.json -e "this.private=false; this.devDependencies=undefined; this.optionalDependencies=undefined; this.scripts=undefined; this.prettier=undefined;"
scripts.patch-esm-ts: node -e "const files = require('shelljs').find('dist/esm/**/*.d.ts'); if (files && files.length) { files.forEach(f=>{var f2=f.replace(/\.ts$/,'.mts');require('fs').renameSync(f,f2);require('shelljs').sed('-i',/ from '(\.[^']+)';$/,' from \'\$1.mjs\';',f2);require('shelljs').sed('-i',/^declare module '(\.[^']+)'/,'declare module \'\$1.mjs\'',f2)}); }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:lint

author: Richard Stovall
